subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept stricter Signal native-only `requireMention` behavior for existing groups that already have configured bot identity but no text mention patterns?
rationale: The code fix is localized and covered, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for existing Signal deployments, so automation should not decide that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept stricter native gating
options.body: Merge with the documented behavior that configured bot identity makes native Signal mention detection enforce `requireMention` and drop unmentioned group chatter into bounded pending context.

options.title: Require a transition path
options.body: Ask for a migration note, compatibility mode, or opt-in strict mode if existing pass-through behavior must remain the default for upgrades.

options.title: Pause the Signal stack
options.body: Hold this PR and its stacked follow-ups if native metadata should not drive Signal group gating yet.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter native gating
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented behavior that configured bot identity makes native Signal mention detection enforce `requireMention` and drop unmentioned group chatter into bounded pending context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared mention-policy and Signal test history makes this the best available routing owner for the compatibility decision.
